design.decision: Bid knowing your team is void in [♣] (ruffing every [♣] lead) and long in [♦]; it shapes how to bid and what to lead.
design.opponent: Revealed when a partner trumps a [♣] trick or shows unexpected [♦] length.
design.rationale: Seed-become-heart (random four cards) measured −15 because it hits trumps and honors; a deterministic, side-suit-only change keeps every [♠] and guarantees a team void, which has standalone ruffing value before any payoff. Duplicate identities are already handled for synthetic cards.

design.hooks: Become with an optional source filter ("from"), where an omitted count means every matching card your team holds; resolves in the existing Opening window.

critic.concerns: Guaranteed team [♣] void is a strong, memorable enabler; duplicate identities (two [K♦]) need a tie-break players can see, and the Nil tag is a stretch.
